cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Closer on My Terms
cards.instruction: Agree to repair the relationship while redefining closeness around the boundaries that benefit you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like a weekend to patch things up. Separate rooms. And please make a list of what needs fixing rather than starting with accusations.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Every item on that list is something you did.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then phrase them as improvements you'd like. 'Listen more,' for example. We can work through those over lunch without spoiling the whole weekend.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need you to hear what actually happened, not edit my list.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Send me the full version before we go. Please, in writing. I'll read it when I'm ready, and at lunch we can stick to the improvements.

reason: Replace generic expertise with editing B's complaints into a process that protects A's comfort and controls when difficult facts are heard.
